videos.title: Video file(s)
videos.description: Video file(s) to track (.mp4, .avi, .mov, ...). Each is predicted on its own and gets its own page in the viewer.

models.title: Trained model folder(s)
models.description: Trained SLEAP model folder(s), each holding best.ckpt and training_config.yaml. One folder for single-instance or bottom-up models; two (centroid and centered instance) for top-down.

tracking.title: Track identities across frames
tracking.description: Link poses across frames into tracks (identities). Off for single-animal videos.

max_instances.title: Animals per frame (0 = no limit)
max_instances.description: Most animals per frame; 0 means no limit. Set it to the number of animals in the arena for cleaner tracks.

title.title: Viewer title
title.description: Title shown at the top of the viewer

gpu.title: Use a GPU
gpu.description: Run inference on a GPU (needs the project's GPU limit above 0). Off runs on CPU, much slower for long videos.

sleap_nn_version.title: sleap-nn version
sleap_nn_version.description: sleap-nn release installed at run time
